name: Agenized for WooCommerce
author: Agenized

sections.description:
If you own a WooCommerce webshop, take a couple of minutes to hear us out. You will not regret it, and it may change how your store sells online.

Today you can install many chatbots on WordPress. Plenty use AI and let you add knowledge about your store. That sounds powerful, but it is only a small part of what is possible.

At Agenized, we specialize in conversational commerce. In simple terms, we try to recreate the feeling of walking into a physical store and getting help from a real sales assistant, in an ecommerce setting.

Why? Because conversion rates rise when customers are guided during the buying journey. In a physical store, that happens naturally. Online, it often does not.

With Agenized you can build as many sales assistants as you want. We call them agents. You can give them what you expect: knowledge, files, URL sources, and safety rules. That helps define who the agent is, where it works, what it knows, and what it can and cannot do.

That may already sound strong, but it is still only part of the story.

What we really focus on is Actions and Proactive Messaging.

For your agent in Agenized you can enable actions. Actions are what give the agent real abilities.

Think of it like this: when you give an employee access to your WooCommerce backend, that person can look up orders, check status, and help customers with real tasks. The same idea applies to an agent in Agenized.

If you enable WooCommerce for your agent, you get a range of actions you can turn on. For example, the agent can search for products, look up orders, resend order confirmations, add notes to orders, cancel orders, refund orders, and more.

These actions are not only plain text. With our Widget Builder, they can be shown with rich UI. As a merchant you can edit them and build your own custom widgets if you want.

With actions you get much closer to a real person managing chat, email, and your other channels. The agent does not only answer questions. It can actually do things.

So far, so good.

Now you are close to the experience of walking into a store and asking a sales assistant at the counter. A good assistant can do more: observe and interact.

When you pick up a pair of jeans in a store, the assistant may step in and ask if you need help with size or want similar products.

At Agenized, our agents can do the same through Proactive Messaging.

Agents can see which pages customers view, how long they stay, and what they have in the cart. That gives a strong base for starting relevant conversations.

So instead of a generic chatbot asking, “Can I help you? Type here,” the customer can get a context-aware message such as: “Those JBL headphones are a great choice. We also have them in other colors if you are interested.”

The goal of proactive messaging is to encourage the customer to start talking to the agent. When they do, the agent can guide the chat, help them forward, and support upsells.

All of this runs through the Agenized Chat Widget, which you can put on your site using this WooCommerce plugin.

It does not stop there.

Besides proactive messaging, you can use the same ideas across other channels you already use, such as email, Messenger, and Instagram.

If the agent is not comfortable answering, it can hand off the conversation to your inbox so you can take over.

Get started: create a free account on the signup page, or sign in if you already have one. Explore plans and conversation limits on Pricing. The main product site is agenized.com.

Try Agenized and this plugin for free

You can test Agenized and this plugin at no cost until you use your free conversations. You can earn more free conversations by completing onboarding tasks and inviting friends. When you go live, your plan includes a monthly allowance of conversations, and you can top up when you need more.

This WordPress plugin connects your site to Agenized so you can:

  • Connect via OAuth: Securely link your Agenized account (sign up or sign in)
  • Select chat channels: Choose which channel powers the storefront widget
  • WooCommerce integration: Connect your catalog and enable store actions for your agents
  • Sitemap integration: Add sitemap sections so agents can use your site content
  • Embed the chat widget: Load the Agenized widget on your WordPress site

Configure agents, actions, proactive rules, and handoff in the Agenized dashboard. This plugin is the bridge between your WordPress store and that experience.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Agenized”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Agenized in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Click Connection and connect your Agenized account via OAuth
  3. Select a chat channel in Channels & Agents
  4. Optionally connect WooCommerce and sitemap sources
sections.faq:
Do I need an Agenized account?

Yes. Create a free account at Agenized signup or sign in at Agenized sign-in. You can also start from the Connection page in the plugin.

What is OAuth?

OAuth is a secure authentication method that allows the plugin to access your Agenized account without storing your password. You’ll be redirected to Agenized to authorize the connection.

Can I use this without WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin works with or without WooCommerce. The WooCommerce integration is optional and allows agents to access your product catalog.

How do I customize the chat widget?

The chat widget appearance and behavior are configured in your Agenized dashboard. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Agenized account.

Does this plugin use third-party services?

Yes. This plugin connects to Agenized services to provide OAuth, widget delivery, channel configuration, and optional WooCommerce integrations.

  • OAuth and API requests are sent to merchant-api.agenized.com.
  • The storefront widget script can be loaded from widget.agenized.com (or your configured script URL).
  • If enabled, order webhooks send order metadata including billing email, order amount, currency, billing phone, order date, and order status.
  • If enabled, proactive context events can send page views, product views, cart totals/item counts, and search terms.
  • If enabled, WooCommerce API credentials created for integration are sent to Agenized APIs to configure catalog/actions.

These features are disabled by default and can be enabled in the plugin settings under Agenized -> Connection -> Advanced Settings.

sections.changelog:
0.2.3

  • Fetch sitemaps using only the WordPress HTTP API (wp_remote_get), per plugin directory guidelines
  • Surface database error details when WooCommerce REST API key creation fails

0.2.0

  • Proactive messaging: send store events (product view, add to cart, cart view, search, checkout error) to the widget
  • Config bridge for iframe embed snippet (AgenizedWidget.publicKey / apiBaseUrl)
  • Requires Widget Script URL set to embed snippet; enable proactive on the channel in the dashboard

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • OAuth connection support
  • Chat channel selection
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Sitemap integration
  • Chat widget embedding
